units.zh: 耶律化哥耶律斡臘耶律速撒蕭阿魯帶耶律那也耶律何魯掃古耶律世良
units.en: Yelu Huage, Yelu Wola, Yelu Susa, Xiao Aludai, Yelu Naye, Yelu Helusaogu, and Yelu Shiliang.
units.literal: Yelu Huage, Yelu Wola, Yelu Susa, Xiao Aludai, Yelu Naye, Yelu Helusaogu, Yelu Shiliang.

units.zh: 耶律化哥，字弘隱，孟父楚國王之後。
units.en: Yelu Huage, whose courtesy name was Hongyin, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.
units.literal: Yelu Huage, courtesy name Hongyin, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 善騎射。
units.en: He excelled at riding and shooting from horseback.
units.literal: He was skilled at mounted archery.

units.zh: 乾亨初，為北院林牙。
units.en: Early in the Qianheng era he was made secretary of the Northern Court.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng, he served as Northern Court Secretary.

units.zh: 統和四年，南侵宋，化哥擒諜者，知敵由海路來襲，即先據平州要地。
units.en: In Tonghe 4, during a southern campaign against Song, Huage captured a spy, learned the enemy would strike by sea, and at once seized the key positions around Ping Prefecture.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, on a southern invasion of Song, Huage captured a spy and learned the enemy would attack by sea; he immediately seized the strategic points of Ping Prefecture.

units.zh: 事平，拜上京留守，遷北院大王。
units.en: After the crisis passed he was appointed garrison commander of the Supreme Capital and promoted to northern great king.
units.literal: When the affair was settled, he was appointed Garrison Commander of the Supreme Capital and transferred to Northern Great King.

units.zh: 十六年，復侵宋，為先鋒，破敵於遂城，以功遷南院大王，尋改北院樞密使。
units.en: In year 16 he again invaded Song as vanguard, routed the enemy at Suicheng, and for his service was made southern great king, then soon reassigned as northern privy council director.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he again invaded Song as vanguard, defeated the enemy at Suicheng, and for his merit was transferred to Southern Great King, soon changed to Northern Privy Council Director.

units.zh: 開泰元年，伐阻卜，阻卜棄輜重遁走，俘獲甚多。
units.en: In Kaitai 1, on campaign against the Zubu, the Zubu abandoned their baggage train and fled, and Huage took a great haul of captives and booty.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaitai, campaigning against the Zubu, the Zubu abandoned baggage and fled; many captives and spoils were taken.

units.zh: 帝嘉之，封豳王。
units.en: The emperor praised him and enfeoffed him as Prince of Bin.
units.literal: The emperor commended him and enfeoffed him as Prince of Bin.

units.zh: 後邊吏奏，自化哥還闕，糧乏馬弱，勢不可守，上復遣化哥經略西境。
units.en: Later frontier officials reported that after Huage returned to court, supplies ran short, horses were weakened, and the frontier could not be held; the emperor sent Huage back to manage the western border.
units.literal: Later frontier officials memorialized that since Huage's return to court, provisions were scarce and horses weak and the position could not be held; the emperor again dispatched Huage to manage the western frontier.

units.zh: 化哥與邊將深入，聞蕃部逆命，居翼只水，化哥徐以兵進。
units.en: Huage marched deep into the frontier with border generals; learning that rebel tribes were encamped on the Yizhi River, he advanced his army at a measured pace.
units.literal: Huage and the frontier generals penetrated deep; hearing that fan tribes had rebelled and were encamped at the Yizhi River, Huage advanced slowly with his troops.

units.zh: 敵望風奔潰，獲羊馬及輜重。
units.en: The enemy broke and fled at the sight of his banners, and he seized sheep, horses, and baggage in great numbers.
units.literal: The enemy fled at sight of his banners; sheep, horses, and baggage were captured.

units.zh: 路由白拔烈，遇阿薩蘭回鶻，掠之。
units.en: On the march through Babelie he encountered the Aslan Uyghurs and plundered them.
units.literal: The route passed through Babelie; he encountered the Aslan Uyghurs and plundered them.

units.zh: 都監裏繼至，謂化哥曰：「君誤矣！
units.en: Chief overseer Li arrived and told Huage, "My lord is mistaken!
units.literal: Chief Overseer Li arrived and said to Huage: "My lord is mistaken!

units.zh: 此部實效順者。」
units.en: This tribe has in fact submitted in good faith."
units.literal: This tribe has in fact submitted in good faith."

units.zh: 化哥悉還所俘。
units.en: Huage returned all the captives.
units.literal: Huage returned all captives.

units.zh: 諸蕃由此不附。
units.en: From that time the frontier tribes would not attach themselves to the court.
units.literal: The various fan tribes therefore would not attach themselves.

units.zh: 上使按之，削王爵。
units.en: The emperor ordered an inquiry and stripped him of his princely title.
units.literal: The emperor ordered an investigation and stripped his princely rank.

units.zh: 以侍中遙領大同軍節度使，卒。
units.en: He was made vice director with nominal command of the Datong army as military commissioner, and died.
units.literal: He was made Vice Director while holding the distant post of Military Commissioner of the Datong Army, and died.

units.zh: 耶律斡臘，字斯寧，奚叠剌部人。
units.en: Yelu Wola, whose courtesy name was Sining, came from the Xi Diela tribe.
units.literal: Yelu Wola, courtesy name Sining, was a man of the Xi Diela tribe.

units.zh: 趫捷有力，善騎射。
units.en: Quick and powerful, he excelled at riding and shooting from horseback.
units.literal: He was nimble and strong, skilled at mounted archery.

units.zh: 保寧初，補護衛。
units.en: Early in the Baoning era he entered service in the imperial guard.
units.literal: At the beginning of Baoning, he was appointed to the guard corps.

units.zh: 車駕獵頡山，適豪豬伏叢莽，帝射中，豬突出。
units.en: On a hunt at Jieshan Mountain, a giant boar lay hidden in the brush; the emperor struck it with an arrow, and the wounded beast charged out.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage hunted on Jieshan, a giant boar happened to lie in ambush in the thickets; the emperor shot and hit it, and the boar burst forth.

units.zh: 禦者托滿舍轡而避，廄人鶴骨翼之，斡臘復射而斃。
units.en: The charioteer Tuoman dropped the reins to swerve aside, the groom Hegu threw himself in protection, and Wola loosed another shot that brought the boar down.
units.literal: The charioteer Tuoman let go the reins to evade; the groom Hegu shielded him, and Wola shot again and killed it.

units.zh: 帝嘉賞。
units.en: The emperor praised and rewarded him.
units.literal: The emperor commended and rewarded him.

units.zh: 及獵赤山，適奔鹿奮角突前，路隘不容避，垂犯蹕。
units.en: On another hunt at Red Mountain, a startled stag lowered its antlers and charged; the trail was too narrow to dodge, and the beast was on the verge of striking the imperial procession.
units.literal: When hunting Red Mountain, a fleeing stag suddenly charged forward tossing its horns; the path was narrow and escape impossible, about to strike the imperial escort.

units.zh: 斡臘以身當之，鹿觸而顛。
units.en: Wola threw himself in its path; the stag struck him and knocked him to the ground.
units.literal: Wola placed his body in the way; the stag struck him and he fell.

units.zh: 帝謂曰：「朕因獵，兩瀕於危，賴卿以免，始見爾心。」
units.en: The emperor told him, "Twice on the hunt I stood at the edge of death, and twice you saved me—now I know where your loyalty lies."
units.literal: The emperor said to him: "Through hunting I twice came near death; relying on you I was spared—now I see your heart."

units.zh: 遷護衛太保。
units.en: He was promoted to Senior Commissioner of the Imperial Guard.
units.literal: He was transferred to Senior Guard Commissioner.

units.zh: 從樞密使耶律斜軫破宋將楊繼業軍於山西。
units.en: He followed the Privy Council director Yelu Xiezhen in crushing the Song commander Yang Ye's forces in Shanxi.
units.literal: He followed Privy Council Director Yelu Xiezhen in defeating the Song general Yang Ye's army in Shanxi.

units.zh: 統和十三年秋，為行軍都監，從都部署奚王和朔奴伐兀惹烏昭度，數月至其城。
units.en: In the autumn of Tonghe 13 he was made chief overseer of the field army and marched with the deployment commissioner, the Xi prince Heshuonu, against the Uyar leader Wuzhaodu; several months passed before they came to his stronghold.
units.literal: In autumn of the thirteenth year of Tonghe, he served as Field Army Chief Overseer, following Chief Deployment Commissioner Xi Prince Heshuonu to attack the Uyar Wuzhaodu; after several months they reached his city.

units.zh: 昭度請降。
units.en: Wuzhaodu offered to submit.
units.literal: Wuzhaodu requested surrender.

units.zh: 和朔奴利其俘掠，令四面急攻。
units.en: Heshuonu, eager for captives and plunder, ordered a fierce assault from every side.
units.literal: Heshuonu coveted the booty and captives and ordered attacks on all four sides.

units.zh: 昭度率眾死守，隨方捍禦。
units.en: Wuzhaodu rallied his people in a desperate defense, beating back attacks wherever they struck.
units.literal: Wuzhaodu led his forces in a stubborn defense, resisting on every side.

units.zh: 依埤堄虛構戰棚，誘我軍登陴，俄撤枝柱，登者盡覆。
units.en: Along the parapets they built sham fighting platforms to lure our men onto the walls, then pulled away the props; every climber was buried beneath the collapse.
units.literal: Along the ramparts they erected false fighting sheds to lure our troops onto the battlements, then swiftly removed the support posts, and all who climbed were crushed.

units.zh: 和朔奴知不能下，欲退。
units.en: Seeing the city could not be taken, Heshuonu wanted to pull back.
units.literal: Heshuonu knew he could not take the city and wished to withdraw.

units.zh: 蕭恒德謂師久無功，何以藉口，若深入大掠，猶勝空返。
units.en: Xiao Hengde argued that they had campaigned for months without victory and asked what face they could show on their return; a deep raid with heavy spoils was still better than going home empty-handed.
units.literal: Xiao Hengde said the army had been long without success and asked what excuse they could offer; if they penetrated deep and plundered heavily, that still beat returning empty-handed.

units.zh: 斡臘曰：「深入，恐所得不償所損。」
units.en: Wola replied, "If we push deep inland, I fear what we gain will not repay what we lose."
units.literal: Wola said: "A deep penetration—I fear the gains will not compensate the losses."

units.zh: 恒德不從，略地東南，循高麗北鄙還。
units.en: Hengde would not heed him. They ravaged the southeast and marched back along Goryeo's northern border.
units.literal: Hengde would not listen; they raided southeast, returned along Korea's northern frontier.

units.zh: 道遠糧絕，人馬多死。
units.en: The march was long, supplies ran out, and men and horses died in great numbers.
units.literal: The road was long and provisions exhausted; many men and horses died.

units.zh: 詔奪諸將官，惟斡臘以前議得免。
units.en: An edict stripped the commanders of rank; only Wola was spared because he had argued against the raid.
units.literal: An edict stripped the generals of their offices; only Wola was spared on account of his earlier counsel.

units.zh: 尋加同政事門下平章事，為東京留守。
units.en: He was soon made associate director of the Directorate for State Affairs and appointed garrison commander of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: Soon he was made Associate Director of the Directorate for Affairs of State and concurrently Eastern Capital Garrison Commander.

units.zh: 開泰中卒。
units.en: He died during the Kaitai period.
units.literal: He died during the Kaitai era.

units.zh: 耶律速撒，字阿敏，性忠直簡毅，練武事。
units.en: Yelu Susa, courtesy name Amin, was loyal and forthright by nature, austere in manner, and thoroughly trained in military affairs.
units.literal: Yelu Susa, courtesy name Amin, was by nature loyal, upright, austere, and practiced in military affairs.

units.zh: 應歷初，為侍從，累遷突呂不部節度使。
units.en: Early in the Yingli reign he entered the emperor's entourage and rose step by step to military commissioner of the Tülübu tribe.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yingli, he became an attendant, and was repeatedly promoted to Military Commissioner of the Tülübu tribe.

units.zh: 歷霸、濟、祥、順、聖五州都總管，俄為敦睦宮太師。
units.en: He served in turn as chief commander of the five prefectures Ba, Ji, Xiang, Shun, and Sheng, and was soon made grand master of the Dunmu Palace.
units.literal: He successively held the post of Chief Commander of the five prefectures Ba, Ji, Xiang, Shun, and Sheng, and soon became Grand Master of the Dunmu Palace.

units.zh: 保寧三年，改九部都詳穩。
units.en: In Baoning 3 he was reassigned as chief commander of the Nine Tribes.
units.literal: In the third year of Baoning, he was changed to Chief Commander of the Nine Tribes.

units.zh: 四年，伐党項，屢立戰功，手詔勞之。
units.en: The next year, on campaign against the Tangut, he won repeated victories; the emperor sent him a personal edict of commendation.
units.literal: In the fourth year, campaigning against the Tangut, he repeatedly won battle honors; the emperor wrote him a personal edict of praise.

units.zh: 統和初，皇太后稱制，西邊甫定，速撒務安集諸蕃，利害輒具以聞，太后益信任之。
units.en: When Tonghe began, the empress dowager ruled as regent and the western frontier had only just been pacified; Susa worked to settle the frontier tribes and reported every advantage and risk in full, and the empress dowager came to rely on him still more.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe, when the Empress Dowager held regency and the western frontier had just been settled, Susa devoted himself to pacifying and gathering the various fan tribes, reporting benefits and harms in full whenever they arose, and the Empress Dowager trusted him all the more.

units.zh: 凡臨戎，與士卒同甘苦，所獲均賜將校。
units.en: Whenever he took command he shared the soldiers' hardships, and whatever was captured he divided evenly among his officers.
units.literal: Whenever he took the field, he shared hardship with the soldiers and distributed booty equally among officers.

units.zh: 賞順討逆，威信大振。
units.en: He rewarded those who submitted and punished rebels, and his authority and reputation spread far.
units.literal: He rewarded the obedient and punished rebels; his authority and prestige rose greatly.

units.zh: 在邊二十年卒。
units.en: He served on the frontier for twenty years and then died.
units.literal: After twenty years on the frontier he died.

units.zh: 蕭阿魯帶，字乙辛隱，烏隗部人。
units.en: Xiao Aludai, whose courtesy name was Yixinyin, came from the Wuwei tribe.
units.literal: Xiao Aludai, courtesy name Yixinyin, was a man of the Wuwei tribe.

units.zh: 父女古，仕至糺詳穩。
units.en: His father Nugu rose in office to the rank of commandant.
units.literal: His father Nugu rose in office to Commandant.

units.zh: 阿魯帶少習騎射，曉兵法。
units.en: From youth Aludai trained in riding and archery and understood military tactics.
units.literal: Aludai in youth practiced mounted archery and understood military tactics.

units.zh: 清寧間始仕，累遷本部司徒，改烏古敵烈統軍都監。
units.en: He first entered service during Qingning, rose step by step to steward of his tribe, and was reassigned as chief overseer of the Wugu-Dilie field army.
units.literal: He first entered service during Qingning, was repeatedly promoted to Steward of his tribe, and was changed to Chief Overseer of the Wugu Dilie Field Army.

units.zh: 大安七年，遷山北副部署。
units.en: In Da'an 7 he was made deputy deployment commissioner of the Northern Mountains.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Da'an, he was transferred to Deputy Deployment Commissioner of the Northern Mountains.

units.zh: 九年，達理得、拔思母二部來侵，率兵擊卻之。
units.en: In year 9 the Dalide and Basimu tribes raided the border; he led troops and beat them back.
units.literal: In the ninth year, the two tribes Dalide and Basimu invaded; he led troops and drove them back.

units.zh: 達理得復劫牛羊去，阿魯帶引兵追及，盡獲所掠，斬渠帥數人。
units.en: Dalide raided again, driving off cattle and sheep; Aludai pursued, recovered everything that had been taken, and beheaded several chieftains.
units.literal: Dalide again raided cattle and sheep and fled; Aludai led troops in pursuit, recovered all that had been plundered, and beheaded several chieftains.

units.zh: 是冬，達理得等以三百餘人梗邊，復戰卻之，斬首二百餘級，加金吾衛上將軍，封蘭陵縣公。
units.en: That winter Dalide and more than three hundred men blocked the frontier; Aludai fought them off again, taking more than two hundred heads, and was made general-in-chief of the Jinwu Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Lanling County.
units.literal: That winter Dalide and others with more than three hundred men blocked the frontier; he fought again and drove them back, taking more than two hundred heads; he was made General-in-Chief of the Jinwu Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Lanling County.

units.zh: 壽隆元年，第功，加同中書門下平章事，進爵郡公，改西北路招討使。
units.en: In Shoulong 1, ranked for merit, he was made associate grand councilor, advanced to duke of a commandery, and reassigned as northwestern route campaign commander.
units.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, ranked for merit, he was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, advanced in rank to Duke of a Commandery, and changed to Northwestern Route Campaign Commander.

units.zh: 乾統三年，坐留宋俘當遣還者為奴，免官。
units.en: In Qiantong 3 he was dismissed from office for keeping Song captives who should have been repatriated and making them slaves.
units.literal: In the third year of Qiantong, for keeping as slaves Song captives who should have been sent back, he was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 後被征，以老疾致仕，卒。
units.en: He was later summoned back to service but retired on account of age and illness, and died.
units.literal: Later he was summoned back, but retired on account of age and illness, and died.

units.zh: 耶律那也，字移斯輦，夷離堇蒲古只之後。
units.en: Yelu Naye, whose courtesy name was Yisinian, was a descendant of Yilijin Puguzhi.
units.literal: Yelu Naye, courtesy name Yisinian, was a descendant of Yilijin Puguzhi.

units.zh: 父斡，嘗為北克，從伐夏戰歿。
units.en: His father Wo had served as a northern ke and died in battle on campaign against Xia.
units.literal: His father Wo had once served as Northern Ke and died in battle on campaign against Xia.

units.zh: 季父趙三，始為宿直官，累遷至北面林牙。
units.en: His uncle Zhao San began as a palace attendant and rose step by step to secretary of the Northern Court.
units.literal: His uncle Zhao San first served as Palace Attendant and was repeatedly promoted to Northern Court Secretary.

units.zh: 咸雍四年，拜北院大王，改西南面招討使。
units.en: In Xianyong 4 he was made northern great king and reassigned as southwestern route campaign commander.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Xianyong, he was appointed Northern Great King and changed to Southwestern Route Campaign Commander.

units.zh: 大康中，西北諸部擾邊，議欲往討，帝以為非趙三不可，遂拜西北路招討使，兼行軍都統，平之，以功復為北院大王。
units.en: During Dakang, when northwestern tribes raided the frontier and an expedition was proposed, the emperor insisted that only Zhao San could lead it; he was made northwestern route campaign commander and field army commander-in-chief, pacified the rebels, and for his service was again made northern great king.
units.literal: During Dakang, northwestern tribes disturbed the frontier; when an expedition was proposed, the emperor thought none but Zhao San would do, and appointed him Northwestern Route Campaign Commander, concurrently Field Army Commander-in-Chief; he pacified them and for his merit was again made Northern Great King.

units.zh: 那也敦厚才敏。
units.en: Naye was sincere and generous, talented and quick-witted.
units.literal: Naye was sincere, generous, talented, and quick-witted.

units.zh: 上以其父斡死王事，九歲加諸衛小將軍，為題裏司徒，尋召為宿直官。
units.en: Because his father Wo had died in the state's service, Naye was at age nine made a junior general of the guards, appointed steward of Tili, and soon summoned as a palace attendant.
units.literal: Because his father Wo died in service to the state, at age nine he was made Junior General of the Guards, appointed Steward of Tili, and soon summoned as Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 大康三年，為遙輦克。
units.en: In Dakang 3 he was made yaolian ke.
units.literal: In the third year of Dakang, he served as Yaolian Ke.

units.zh: 大安九年，為倒塌嶺節度使。
units.en: In Da'an 9 he was made military commissioner of Daotaoling.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Da'an, he was made Military Commissioner of Daotaoling.

units.zh: 明年冬，以北阻卜長磨古斯叛，與招討都監耶律胡呂率精騎二千往討，破之。
units.en: The next winter, when the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi rebelled, he and campaign chief overseer Yelu Hulu led two thousand elite cavalry against him and defeated him.
units.literal: The next winter, because the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi rebelled, he together with Campaign Chief Overseer Yelu Hulu led two thousand elite cavalry to subdue him and defeated him.

units.zh: 那也薦胡呂為漢人行宮副部署。
units.en: Naye recommended Hulu for appointment as deputy deployment commissioner of the Han palace.
units.literal: Naye recommended Hulu as Deputy Deployment Commissioner of the Han Palace.

units.zh: 壽隆元年，復討達理得、拔思母等有功，賜詔褒美，改烏古敵烈部統軍使，邊境以寧。
units.en: In Shoulong 1, on renewed campaigns against Dalide, Basimu, and others he won further merit, received an edict of commendation, was made commander of the Wugu-Dilie field army, and the frontier was pacified.
units.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, campaigning again against Dalide, Basimu, and others with merit, he was granted an edict of praise, changed to Commander of the Wugu Dilie Field Army, and the frontier was pacified.

units.zh: 部民乞留，詔許再任。
units.en: The tribesmen asked that he stay on, and an edict allowed him to serve another term.
units.literal: The tribesmen begged that he remain; an edict permitted him to serve another term.

units.zh: 乾統六年，拜中京留守，改北院大王，薨。
units.en: In Qiantong 6 he was made garrison commander of the Central Capital, reassigned as northern great king, and died.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Qiantong, he was appointed Garrison Commander of the Central Capital, changed to Northern Great King, and died.

units.zh: 那也為人廉介，長於理民，每有鬥訟，親核曲直，不尚威嚴，常曰：「凡治人，本欲分別是非，何事迫脅以立名。」
units.en: Naye was upright and incorruptible, and excelled at governing the people; whenever disputes arose he judged the rights and wrongs himself, without leaning on intimidation, and often said, "The point of governing people is to tell right from wrong—why browbeat them merely to build a reputation?"
units.literal: Naye was by nature incorruptible, skilled at governing the people; whenever there were lawsuits he personally examined right and wrong, did not rely on severity, and often said: "In governing people, the aim is to distinguish right from wrong—why force and coerce to build a reputation?"

units.zh: 胡所至以惠化稱。
units.en: Wherever he served he was praised for ruling through kindness.
units.literal: Wherever he went he was acclaimed for benevolent transformation.

units.zh: 耶律何魯掃古，字烏古鄰，孟父房之後。
units.en: Yelu Helusaogu, whose courtesy name was Wugulin, was a descendant of the Mengfu branch of the imperial clan.
units.literal: Yelu Helusaogu, courtesy name Wugulin, was a descendant of the Mengfu house.

units.zh: 重熙末，補祗候郎君。
units.en: Late in the Chongxi era he was appointed an attendant gentleman.
units.literal: At the end of Chongxi, he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.

units.zh: 清寧初，加安州團練使。
units.en: Early in Qingning he was made training commissioner of An Prefecture.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he was made Training Commissioner of An Prefecture.

units.zh: 大康中，歷懷德軍節度使、奚六部禿裏太尉。
units.en: During Dakang he served in turn as military commissioner of the Huaide army and as grand commandant tuli of the Six Xi Tribes.
units.literal: During Dakang, he successively held the posts of Military Commissioner of the Huaide Army and Grand Commandant Tuli of the Six Xi Tribes.

units.zh: 詔與樞密官措畫東北邊事，改左護衛太保。
units.en: He was ordered to work with privy council officials on northeastern frontier strategy and was made senior commissioner of the left guard.
units.literal: He was ordered with privy council officials to plan northeastern frontier affairs and was made Senior Guard Commissioner of the Left.

units.zh: 侍上，言多率易，察無他腸，以故上優貸之。
units.en: In the emperor's presence he spoke bluntly and without ceremony; inquiry showed no hidden designs, and for that reason the throne treated him with indulgence.
units.literal: In attendance on the emperor his speech was often blunt and unguarded; investigation showed no ulterior motives, and for this reason the emperor treated him leniently.

units.zh: 大安八年，知西北路招討使事。
units.en: In Da'an 8 he took charge of northwestern route frontier campaigns.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Da'an, he was made commander of Northwestern Route campaigns.

units.zh: 時邊部耶睹刮等來侵，何魯掃古誘北阻卜酋豪磨古斯攻之，俘獲甚眾，以功加左僕射。
units.en: When the frontier tribes led by Yeduogua raided the border, Helusaogu induced the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi to strike them, took a great haul of captives, and was promoted to left vice director for his service.
units.literal: At that time the frontier tribes Yeduogua and others invaded; Helusaogu induced the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi to attack them, taking many captives, and for his merit was made Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 復討耶睹刮等，誤擊磨古斯，北阻卜由是叛命。
units.en: On a renewed campaign against Yeduogua and his allies he mistakenly attacked Mogusi, and the Northern Zubu thereupon rebelled.
units.literal: Campaigning again against Yeduogua and others, he mistakenly struck Mogusi, and the Northern Zubu therefore rebelled.

units.zh: 遣都監張九討之，不克，二室韋與六院部、特滿群牧、宮分等軍俱陷於敵。
units.en: The overseer Zhang Jiu was sent to suppress them but failed; the two Shiwei divisions, together with the Six Yuan Division, the Temun herd office, the palace garrison troops, and other units, were all lost to the enemy.
units.literal: Commissioner Zhang Jiu was dispatched to subdue them but failed; the two Shiwei divisions together with the Six Yuan Divisions, Temun Herd Office, Garrison Division, and other forces all fell to the enemy.

units.zh: 何魯掃古不以實聞，坐是削官，決以大杖。
units.en: Helusaogu failed to report what had really happened; for that his offices were stripped and he was sentenced to a heavy beating.
units.literal: Helusaogu did not report the truth; for this his office was stripped and he was sentenced to heavy beating.

units.zh: 壽隆間，累遷惕隱，兼侍中，賜保節功臣。
units.en: During Shoulong he rose through several posts to tiyin and vice director, and was granted the title of meritorious minister who preserves integrity.
units.literal: During Shoulong he was repeatedly promoted to Tiyin, concurrently Vice Director, and granted the title Meritorious Minister who Preserves Integrity.

units.zh: 道宗崩，與宰相耶律儼總山陵事。
units.en: When Emperor Daozong died, he and the chancellor Yelu Yi jointly directed the imperial tomb works.
units.literal: When Daozong died, he together with Chancellor Yelu Yi oversaw the imperial tomb.

units.zh: 乾統中，致仕，卒。
units.en: Under Qiantong he retired from office and died.
units.literal: During Qiantong he retired and died.

units.zh: 耶律世良，小字斡，六院部人。
units.en: Yelu Shiliang, known in youth as Wo, came from the Six Yuan Division.
units.literal: Yelu Shiliang, childhood name Wo, was a man of the Six Yuan Division.

units.zh: 才敏給，練達國朝典故及世譜。
units.en: Quick-witted and capable, he had mastered the court's precedents and the imperial genealogies.
units.literal: Talented and quick-witted, versed in dynastic precedents and genealogies.

units.zh: 上書與族弟敵烈爭嫡庶，帝始識之。
units.en: He submitted a memorial disputing legitimacy of birth with his clansman Dilie, and the emperor first took notice of him.
units.literal: He submitted a memorial disputing with his clansman Dilie over legitimacy of birth; the emperor first took notice of him.

units.zh: 時北院樞密使韓德讓病，帝問：「孰可代卿？」
units.en: When the northern privy council director Han Derang fell ill, the emperor asked, "Who can take your place?"
units.literal: At that time Northern Privy Council Director Han Derang was ill; the emperor asked: "Who can replace you?"

units.zh: 德讓曰：「世良可。」
units.en: Derang answered, "Shiliang will do."
units.literal: Derang said: "Shiliang will do."

units.zh: 北院大王耶律室魯復問北院之選，德讓曰：「無出世良。」
units.en: The northern great king Yelu Shilu asked again who should lead the northern court; Derang said, "No one stands above Shiliang."
units.literal: Northern Great King Yelu Shilu again asked about the Northern selection; Derang said: "No one surpasses Shiliang."

units.zh: 統和末，為北院大王。
units.en: At the end of Tonghe he was made northern great king.
units.literal: At the end of Tonghe he became Northern Great King.

units.zh: 開泰初，因大冊禮，加檢校太尉、同政事門下平章事。
units.en: Early in Kaitai, on the great enthronement ceremony, he was made honorary grand commandant and associate director of the directorate for state affairs.
units.literal: At the beginning of Kaitai, on the occasion of the great enthronement rites, he was made Honorary Grand Commandant and Associate Director of the Directorate for Affairs of State.

units.zh: 時邊部拒命，詔北院樞密使耶律化哥將兵，以世良為都監，往禦之。
units.en: When frontier tribes defied orders, the court ordered the northern privy council director Yelu Huage to take the field, with Shiliang as chief overseer, to repel them.
units.literal: At that time the frontier tribes refused obedience; the emperor ordered Northern Privy Council Director Yelu Huage to lead troops, with Shiliang as chief overseer, to resist them.

units.zh: 明年，化哥還，將罷兵，世良上書曰：「化哥以為無事而還，不思師老糧乏，敵人已去，焉能久守？
units.en: The following year Huage returned and was about to disband the army; Shiliang memorialized, "Huage thinks all is well and comes home, heedless of our weary troops and empty stores; the enemy has only withdrawn—how can they be held at bay for long?
units.literal: The next year Huage returned and was about to withdraw the army; Shiliang submitted a memorial saying: "Huage thinks there is nothing amiss and returns, without considering that the army is weary and provisions scarce; the enemy has already gone—how can they be held long?

units.zh: 若益兵，可克也。」
units.en: Reinforce the army and they can still be defeated."
units.literal: If troops are increased, they can be conquered."

units.zh: 帝即命化哥益兵，與世良追之。
units.en: The emperor at once ordered Huage to add troops and pursue with Shiliang.
units.literal: The emperor immediately ordered Huage to reinforce the army and pursue together with Shiliang.

units.zh: 至安真河，大破而還。
units.en: At the Anzhen River they won a crushing victory and returned.
units.literal: Reaching the Anzhen River, they won a great victory and returned.

units.zh: 自是邊境以寧。
units.en: From that time the frontier was calm.
units.literal: From then on the frontier was at peace.

units.zh: 以功王岐，拜北院樞密使。
units.en: For his service he was enfeoffed as prince of Qi and appointed northern privy council director.
units.literal: For his merit he was enfeoffed Prince of Qi and appointed Northern Privy Council Director.

units.zh: 三年，命選馬駝於烏古部。
units.en: In the third year of his tenure he was ordered to levy horses and camels from the Ugu tribe.
units.literal: In the third year, he was ordered to select horses and camels from the Ugu tribe.

units.zh: 會敵烈部人夷剌殺其酋長稍瓦而叛，鄰部皆應，攻陷巨母古城。
units.en: Then Yila of the Dilie tribe murdered his chieftain Shaowa and rose in revolt; neighboring tribes joined him and they stormed Jumu Old City.
units.literal: When Yila of the Dilie tribe killed his chieftain Shaowa and rebelled, neighboring tribes all responded, and they captured and overran Jumu Old City.

units.zh: 世良率兵壓境，遣人招之，降數部，各復故地。
units.en: Shiliang marched to the border, sent envoys to win them over, and several tribes submitted and were restored to their former lands.
units.literal: Shiliang led troops to press the border, sent men to summon them; several tribes submitted and each recovered their former territory.

units.zh: 四年，伐高麗，為副部署。
units.en: In the fourth year, on the campaign against Goryeo, he served as deputy deployment commissioner.
units.literal: In the fourth year, campaigning against Goryeo, he served as deputy deployment commissioner.

units.zh: 都統劉慎行逗留失期，執還京師，世良獨進兵。
units.en: The commander-in-chief Liu Shenxing lingered and missed the rendezvous; he was arrested and sent back to the capital, and Shiliang pressed forward alone.
units.literal: Commander-in-Chief Liu Shenxing delayed and missed the rendezvous; he was seized and sent back to the capital, and Shiliang advanced alone.

units.zh: 明年，至北都護府，破追兵於郭州。
units.en: The next year he reached the northern capital protectorate and routed pursuing troops at Guo Prefecture.
units.literal: The next year, reaching the Northern Capital Protectorate, he defeated pursuing troops at Guo Prefecture.

units.zh: 以暴疾卒。
units.en: He died suddenly of a violent illness.
units.literal: He died suddenly of acute illness.

units.zh: 論曰：大之懷小也以德，制之也以威。
units.en: The historian remarks: The great win the loyalty of the small through virtue and restrain them through might.
units.literal: Commentary says: The great wins over the small through virtue and controls them through might.

units.zh: 德不足懷，威不足制，而欲服人也難矣。
units.en: When virtue is too thin to win hearts and might too weak to enforce obedience, making others submit is hard indeed.
units.literal: When virtue is insufficient to win hearts and might insufficient to control, wishing to make people submit is difficult indeed.

units.zh: 化哥利俘獲，而諸蕃不附，何魯掃古誤擊磨古斯，而阻卜叛命，是皆喜於一旦之功，而不圖後日之患，庸何議焉。
units.en: Huage prized captives while the frontier tribes would not attach themselves; Helusaogu struck Mogusi by mistake and the Zubu rebelled—these men rejoiced in a single day's gain and gave no thought to tomorrow's trouble; what is there to commend?
units.literal: Huage coveted captives yet the various fan did not attach themselves; Helusaogu mistakenly struck Mogusi and the Zubu rebelled—these all delighted in momentary achievement without planning for later troubles; what is there to praise?

units.zh: 若斡臘之戒深入，速撒之務安集，亦鐵中之錚錚者邪？
units.en: Yet are not Wola, who warned against pushing too deep, and Susa, who labored to settle the tribes, the true steel among iron?
units.literal: Yet if Wola's caution against deep penetration and Susa's work to pacify and gather—are these not the ringing iron among iron?

units.zh: 耶律頹昱，字團寧，孟父楚國王之後。
units.en: Yelu Tuiyu, whose courtesy name was Tuanning, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.
units.literal: Yelu Tuiyu, courtesy name Tuanning, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 太宗崩，諸大臣立世宗，太后聞之，怒甚，遣皇子李胡以兵逆擊，遇安端、劉哥等於泰德泉，敗歸。
units.en: After Emperor Taizong died, the senior ministers enthroned Emperor Shizong. When the empress dowager heard of this she was furious and sent the prince Li Hu with an army to oppose them; at Taidede Spring he met Anduan, Liuge, and their forces, was defeated, and withdrew.
units.literal: When Taizong died, the great ministers enthroned Shizong. The empress dowager heard of it and was furious; she sent the prince Li Hu with troops to strike back, met Anduan, Liuge, and others at Taidede Spring, and was defeated and returned.

units.zh: 三月壬午，耶律速撒等獻党項俘，分賜群臣。
units.en: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed among the ministers.
units.literal: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed as gifts among the ministers.

units.zh: 辛丑，耶律沙遣人上俘獲，以權知南京留守事韓德讓、權南京馬步軍都指揮使耶律學古、知三司事劉弘皆能安人心，捍城池，並賜詔褒獎。
units.en: On xinchou day Yelü Sha sent up prisoners; edicts commended Han Derang, acting Nanjing regent, Yelü Xuegu, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander, and Liu Hong, director of the Three Departments, for steadying morale and holding the city.
units.literal: On xinchou day, Yelü Sha sent men presenting captives; because acting Nanjing regent Han Derang, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander Yelü Xuegu, and Director of the Three Departments Liu Hong had all been able to steady hearts and defend the walls, edicts of praise and reward were granted to each.

units.zh: 十二月，以遼興軍節度使韓德讓為南院樞密使。
units.en: In the twelfth month Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was appointed Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was made Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 夏六月，以西南面招討使耶律斜軫為北院大王。
units.en: In the sixth summer month Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was appointed Northern Court Great King.
units.literal: In the sixth month of summer, Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was made Northern Court Great King.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 己亥，以北院大王耶律室魯為北院樞密使，封韓王，北院郎君耶律世良為北院大王，前三司使劉慎行參知政事兼知南院樞密使事。
units.en: On jihai day Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han; Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Chancellery Great King; and former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner and concurrent Southern Privy Commissioner.
units.literal: On jihai day, Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han, Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was Northern Chancellery Great King, former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was Associate Administrative Affairs commissioner and concurrently Southern Privy Commissioner.

units.zh: 乙未，以劉慎行為南院樞密使，南府宰相邢抱質知南院樞密使事。
units.en: On yiwei day Liu Shenxing was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner and Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi was assigned to manage Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.
units.literal: On yiwei day, made Liu Shenxing Southern Privy Commissioner, Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi to know Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 二十九年春正月乙亥朔，班師，所降諸城復叛。
units.en: In the twenty-ninth year, on the yihai new moon of the first spring month the army withdrew; the cities that had surrendered all rebelled again.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on yihai new moon, army withdrew; the surrendered cities all rebelled again.

units.zh: 以南院大王勃古哲總領山西諸州事，北院大王、於越休哥為南面行軍都統，奚王和朔奴副之，同政事門下平章事蕭道寧領本部軍駐南京。
units.en: Southern Route great king Boguzhe was placed in overall charge of the western circuits; Northern Route great king and yuyue Xiuge was made Southern Route campaign commander-in-chief, with Xi King Heshuonu as his deputy; co-chancellor under the Gate Xiao Daoning led his own army in garrison at Nanjing.
units.literal: Southern Route great king Boguzhe was put in overall charge of the western circuits; Northern Route great king and yuyue Xiuge was made Southern Route campaign commander-in-chief, with Xi King Heshuonu as his deputy; co-chancellor under the Gate Xiao Daoning led his own army in garrison at Nanjing.

units.zh: 戊寅，遣使賜於越休哥及奚王籌寧、統軍使頗德等湯藥。
units.en: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with medicinal broth for yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, circuit military commissioner Pide, and others.
units.literal: On wuyin day envoys were sent with medicinal broth to yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, circuit military commissioner Pide, and others.

units.zh: 召樞密直學士耶律儼講《尚書·洪範》。
units.en: Privy Council academician Yelü Yan was summoned to lecture on the 《Hongfan》 chapter of the 《Book of Documents》.
units.literal: Summoned Privy Council academician Yelü Yan to lecture on the 《Hongfan》 chapter of the 《Book of Documents》.

units.zh: 三月辛巳，速撒遣人以別部化哥等降，納之。
units.en: On xinsi day in the third month Susa reported that Huage and other chiefs of a detached division had submitted, and they were received.
units.literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, Susa sent men reporting that chieftains of a separate division, Huage and others, had surrendered; they were accepted.

units.zh: 三月丁亥，西南面招討副使耶律王六、太尉化哥遣人獻党項俘。
units.en: On dinghai day in the third month Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men with Tangut prisoners.
units.literal: In the third month, on dinghai day, Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men presenting Tangut captives.

units.zh: 北阻卜耶睹刮率鄰部來侵，奪剌逆擊，追奔數十里。
units.en: When the Northern Zubu chieftain Yeduogua led neighboring tribes in an invasion, Duola counterattacked and pursued the fleeing enemy for several tens of li.
units.literal: The Northern Zubu chieftain Yeduogua led neighboring tribes in an invasion; Duola counterattacked and pursued the fleeing enemy for several tens of li.

units.zh: 二年，乘耶睹刮無備，以輕騎襲之，獲馬萬五千匹，牛羊稱是。
units.en: The next year, taking advantage of Yeduogua's unpreparedness, he struck with light cavalry and captured fifteen thousand horses and a comparable number of cattle and sheep.
units.literal: In the second year, taking advantage of Yeduogua's unpreparedness, he raided with light cavalry, capturing fifteen thousand horses and a comparable number of cattle and sheep.

units.zh: 甲辰，以同知南京留守事耶律那也知右夷離畢事。
units.en: On jiachen day associate regent of Nanjing Yelü Naye was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
units.literal: On jiachen day associate regent of Nanjing Yelü Naye administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

units.zh: 庚辰，以遼興軍節度使周王胡都古為臨海軍節度使，漆水郡王敵烈南院大王。
units.en: On gengchen day Prince Zhou Hu Dugu was transferred from the Liaoxing Army to the Linhai Army, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie was appointed Southern Court great king.
units.literal: On gengchen day made Liaoxing Army military commissioner Prince Zhou Hu Dugu Linhai Army military commissioner, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie Southern Court great king.

units.zh: 是月，以東京留守蕭恒德等伐高麗。
units.en: That month Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde and others were sent to attack Goryeo.
units.literal: That month Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde and others attacked Goryeo.

units.zh: 己丑，以阻卜磨古斯為諸部長。
units.en: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.
units.literal: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.

units.zh: 辛酉，阻卜磨古斯殺金吾吐古斯以叛，遣奚六部禿裏耶律郭三發諸蕃部兵討之。
units.en: On xinyou day Zubu Mogusi killed Defender of the Golden Crow Tugusi and rebelled; Xi Six Tribes Tulie Yelü Guosan was dispatched to lead various tribal troops against him.
units.literal: On xinyou day Zubu Mogusi killed Defender of the Golden Crow Tugusi and rebelled; dispatched Xi Six Tribes Tulie Yelü Guosan to lead various tribal troops against him.

units.zh: 二月，磨古斯來侵。
units.en: In the second month Mogusi came to invade.
units.literal: Second month, Mogusi came to invade.

units.zh: 三月，西北路招討使耶律阿魯掃古追磨古斯還，都監蕭張九遇賊，與戰不利。
units.en: In the third month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Arusaguo pursued Mogusi back; inspector-general Xiao Zhangjiu encountered the bandits and fighting was unfavorable.
units.literal: Third month, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Arusaguo pursued Mogusi back; inspector-general Xiao Zhangjiu encountered the bandits and fighting was unfavorable.

units.zh: 冬十月庚戌，有司奏磨古斯詣西北路招討使耶律撻不也偽降，既而乘虛來襲，撻不也死之。
units.en: On gengxu day of the tenth winter month the relevant offices memorialized that Mogusi feigned surrender to Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Tabuye, then seized an opening to attack; Tabuye died in the fight.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu day the relevant offices memorialized that Mogusi feigned surrender to Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Tabuye, then seized an opening to attack; Tabuye died in the fight.

units.zh: 庚戌，以知北院樞密使事耶律斡特剌為都統，夷離畢耶律禿朵為副統，龍虎衛上將軍耶律胡呂都監，討磨古斯，遣積慶宮使蕭虬裏監戰。
units.en: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.
units.literal: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.

units.zh: 是月，斡特剌破磨古斯。
units.en: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.
units.literal: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.

units.zh: 戊子，西北路統軍司奏討磨古斯捷。
units.en: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
units.literal: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.

units.zh: 甲寅，以奚王府監軍耶律室魯為南院大王。
units.en: On jiayin day Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu was appointed southern chancellery great king.
units.literal: On jiayin day made Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu Southern Chancellery Great King.

units.zh: 壬戌，以討北部功，烏古敵烈部詳穩耶律巢知北院大王事，都監蕭阿魯帶烏古敵烈部詳穩，加左監門衛上將軍。
units.en: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai was made Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable and promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
units.literal: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable, promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

units.zh: 三月甲戌，於越休哥奏宋遣曹彬、崔彥進、米信由雄州道，田重進飛狐道，潘美、楊繼業雁門道來侵，岐溝、涿州、固安、新城皆陷。
units.en: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge reported that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.
units.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge memorialized that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.

units.zh: 秋七月丙子，樞密使斜軫遣侍御涅裏底、幹勤哥奏復朔州，擒宋將楊繼業，及上所獲將校印綬、誥敕，賜涅裏底等酒及銀器。
units.en: On bingzi day in the seventh autumn month Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye, and to submit the captured officers’ seals, cords, patents, and orders; Nielidi and the others received wine and silver vessels.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye, and to present the seals, cords, patents, and orders taken by the Emperor; Nielidi and others were granted wine and silver vessels.

units.zh: 自是宋守雲、應諸州者，聞繼業死，皆棄城遁。
units.en: From then on Song defenders of Yun, Ying, and the other prefectures, hearing that Jiye was dead, all abandoned their cities and fled.
units.literal: From this time Song defenders of Yun, Ying, and other prefectures, hearing of Jiye's death, all abandoned their cities and fled.

units.zh: 宋將楊繼業初以驍勇自負，號楊無敵，北據雲、朔數州，至是，引兵南出朔州三十里，至狼牙村，惡其名，不進；
units.en: Song general Yang Jiye had prided himself on martial prowess and was called Yang the Invincible; holding Yun, Shuozhou, and several northern prefectures, he now led his force thirty li south from Shuozhou to Langya Village, but disliking the name he refused to go farther;
units.literal: Song general Yang Jiye had at first prided himself on martial prowess and was called Yang the Invincible; holding Yun and Shuozhou and several prefectures in the north, at this time he led troops south thirty li from Shuozhou to Langya Village; disliking the name, he would not advance;

units.zh: 遇斜軫，伏四起，中流矢，墮馬被擒。
units.en: He met Xiezhen; ambushes sprang up on every side; struck by an arrow he fell from his horse and was taken.
units.literal: He encountered Xiezhen; ambushes rose on every side; he was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured.

units.zh: 瘡發不食，三日死。
units.en: His wounds festered; he took no food and died after three days.
units.literal: His wounds festered; he ate nothing and died after three days.

units.zh: 祖蒲古只，遙輦氏時再為本部夷離堇。
units.en: His grandfather Pugu Zhi had twice served as tribal chieftain of their division under the Yaolian clan.
units.literal: His grandfather Pugu Zhi twice served as Yilijin of this division in the time of the Yaolian clan.

units.zh: 蒲古只以計誘其黨，悉誅夷之。
units.en: Pugu Zhi lured their faction into a trap by stratagem and put them all to death.
units.literal: Pugu Zhi by stratagem lured out their faction and executed them all.

units.zh: 丁巳，兀惹烏昭度、渤海燕頗等侵鐵驪，遣奚王和朔奴等討之。
units.en: On dingsi day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, Bohai Yanpo, and others invaded the Iron Li, and Xi King Heshuonu and others were dispatched to attack them.
units.literal: On dingsi day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, Bohai Yanpo, and others invaded the Iron Li; Xi King Heshuonu and others were dispatched to attack them.

units.zh: 戊午，烏昭度乞內附。
units.en: On wuwu day Wuzhaodu asked to submit and be incorporated.
units.literal: On wuwu day Wuzhaodu begged to come submit internally.

units.zh: 女直趙三、阿鶻產拒之，阿骨打虜其家屬。
units.en: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.
units.literal: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.

units.zh: 翌日，赴詳穩司，與趙三等面折庭下。
units.en: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.
units.literal: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.

units.zh: 九月丁酉，八部敵烈殺其詳穩稍瓦，皆叛，詔南府宰相耶律吾剌葛招撫之。
units.en: On dingyou day of the ninth month the eight tribes of Dilie killed their Xiaowen commander Shaowa and all rebelled; an edict ordered Southern Court Grand Chancellor Yelü Wulage to win them over.
units.literal: Ninth month, on dingyou day the eight tribes of Dilie killed their Xiaowen commander Shaowa and all rebelled; an edict ordered Southern Court Grand Chancellor Yelü Wulage to win them over.

units.zh: 丁酉，以惕隱耶律何魯掃古為南院大王。
units.en: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.
units.literal: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.
